content:
一个可选的功能扩展模组为**NeoForge版的Curios**添加了支持，为以下精致存储工具提供了两个专属饰品槽位：

- [无线网格终端](https://refinedmods.com/refined-storage/wireless-networking/wireless-grid.html)  
- [创造模式无线网格终端](https://refinedmods.com/refined-storage/wireless-networking/creative-wireless-grid.html)  
- [无线合成终端](https://refinedmods.com/refined-storage/wireless-networking/wireless-crafting-grid.html)  
- [创造模式无线合成终端](https://refinedmods.com/refined-storage/wireless-networking/creative-wireless-crafting-grid.html)  
- [便携式网格终端](https://refinedmods.com/refined-storage/viewing-resources/portable-grid.html)  
- [创造模式便携式网格终端](https://refinedmods.com/refined-storage/viewing-resources/creative-portable-grid.html)

你可以配合快捷键绑定功能，在装备时快速打开这些工具。

![饰品槽位示意图](https://refinedmods.com/curios.1faca87d.png)
